title: Simultaneous speech and gesture decoding for multimodal communication in paralysis
title_zh: 并行语音与手势解码：瘫痪患者多模态沟通的脑机接口
abstract: Abstract Stroke and neurodegenerative diseases can impair speech and nonverbal gestures, limiting natural communication. Brain–computer interfaces (BCIs) aim to restore these functions by translating neural activity into commands for external devices, although prior work has primarily focused on decoding speech or gestures in isolation. Here we show that neural signals recorded with a single high-density electrocorticography implant can support simultaneous decoding of speech and gestures in people with paralysis. We first show that isolated upper-limb and orofacial movements can be reliably decoded among three participants. Using parallel speech and gesture decoders, we then enabled participants to control a personalized virtual avatar by attempting speech and gestures simultaneously or in isolation. Training models on both isolated and simultaneous data improved performance across behavioral contexts. These findings demonstrate that one cortical implant can support multi-effector control and provide a step toward BCIs that enable more natural communication for people with paralysis.
abstract_zh: 摘要：中风和神经退行性疾病可能损害语音和非语言手势，限制自然沟通。脑机接口（BCI）旨在通过将神经活动转换为外部设备的指令来恢复这些功能，然而以往研究主要聚焦于单独解码语音或手势。本文展示了使用单一高密度皮层电图植入物记录的神经信号，能够在瘫痪患者中同时解码语音和手势。首先，我们证明在三名受试者中，单独的上肢和口面运动可以被可靠解码。随后，利用并行的语音和手势解码器，使受试者能够通过同时或单独尝试语音和手势来控制个性化的虚拟头像。对单独和并行数据进行训练的模型在不同行为情境下均提升了性能。这些发现表明，一个皮层植入物即可支持多效器控制，为实现更自然沟通的瘫痪患者脑机接口迈出了重要一步。
